site.name: 121XML AI OS
site.// name_doc: Human-readable name of your 121XML instance (e.g., 'Acme Banking 121XML', 'Healthcare 121XML')
site.// version_doc: Configuration schema version - increment when structure changes
site.// created_doc: ISO 8601 date when this configuration was created
site.description: Unified 121XML platform with multi-engine AI support and comprehensive XML specification knowledge base
site.// description_doc: Brief description of this 121XML deployment and its purpose

objectStore.// objectStore_overview: Configure where and how user objects are stored locally

default.// default_object_store: Primary location for saving all user objects
default.// location_doc: REQUIRED: Full path where objects will be stored. Examples: '/var/www/121xml/data/objects', '/home/user/121xml/objects', 'C:\121xml\objects'
default.// location_example: Update this path based on your server setup. Ensure directory exists and is writable.
default.// compression_doc: Enable lossless compression (94% token savings): true or false. Recommended: true
default.// contentAddressing_doc: Enable SHA256 content addressing: true or false. Recommended: true (immutability guarantee)
default.// immutable_doc: Prevent modification of objects after creation: true or false. Recommended: true

backup.// backup_config: Configure automatic backups of object store
backup.// backup_enabled_doc: Enable automatic backups: true or false
backup.// backup_location_doc: REQUIRED: Full path for backup storage (separate from primary objects)
backup.// backup_location_example: Should be on different disk/storage than primary for redundancy
backup.// backup_retention_doc: Keep backups for this many days. Example: 90 (3 months)

userProjects.// userProjects_config: Storage for grouped user work (projects, campaigns, initiatives)
userProjects.// userProjects_location_doc: Full path where project folders will be stored
userProjects.// userProjects_maxSize_doc: Maximum project size per user in MB. Default: 5000 (5 GB)
userProjects.// quota_enforcement_doc: Enforce storage quota: true or false. true = prevents exceeding maxSizeMB

aiEngines.// aiEngines_overview: Configure AI engines and API credentials for 121XML backend
// aiEngines_setup_instructions: 1. CRITICAL: Never commit actual API keys to version control
2. Use ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES for all sensitive credentials
3. Set environment variables on your server before deployment
5. Verify all required engines have API keys before deployment

userInteraction.// userInteraction_overview: Track and analyze how users interact with the 121XML platform

tracking.// tracking_enabled_doc: Enable user interaction logging: true or false
tracking.// tracking_location_doc: Path where interaction logs are stored
tracking.// retention_days_doc: Keep interaction logs for N days (365 = 1 year)
tracking.// fields_doc: Data points captured for each user interaction

analytics.// analytics_enabled_doc: Enable analytics dashboard: true or false
analytics.// dashboardLocation_doc: URL path where analytics dashboard is accessible

userWorkspace.// userWorkspace_overview: Configuration for user projects, conversations, memories, and objects

projects.// projects_location_doc: REQUIRED: Path where user project folders stored
projects.// defaultQuotaMB_doc: Max project size per user in MB (5000 = 5 GB)

conversations.// conversations_doc: Chat history and AI interactions per project
conversations.// conversations_location_doc: REQUIRED: Path where conversation records stored

memories.// memories_doc: Context, preferences, knowledge base per user/project
memories.// memories_location_doc: REQUIRED: Path where memory files stored
types.// context_notes: User notes, project context, background info
types.// project_history: Timeline of project activities and decisions
types.// preferences: User UI preferences, export formats, favorite engines
types.// shortcuts: Custom conversion shortcuts, templates, saved workflows

objects.// objects_location_doc: REQUIRED: Primary path for user-uploaded objects
objects.// indexing_doc: Enable full-text search: true or false
objects.// searchable_doc: Make objects queryable via API: true or false
objects.// versionControl_doc: Track object versions: true or false. true = keep change history

authentication.// refresh_token_doc: Refresh token lifetime for token renewal

audit.// audit_enabled_doc: Enable security audit logging: true or false
audit.// audit_fields_doc: Data captured in audit log for compliance

dataProtection.// dataProtection_overview: 121XML lossless compression, archival, and recovery guarantees

contentAddressing.// contentAddressing_enabled_doc: Enable SHA256 content addressing: true or false (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED)
contentAddressing.// immutable_doc: Make objects immutable after creation: true or false (RECOMMENDED)

compression.// compression_ratio_doc: Expected compression rate: 94% means 6% of original size remains
compression.// dataLoss_doc: Data loss percentage: 0.0 = LOSSLESS (100% recovery guaranteed)

archival.// archival_enabled_doc: Enable immutable archival: true or false
archival.// archival_location_doc: REQUIRED: Path for immutable archive storage

api.// baseUrl_doc: REQUIRED: Base URL for API calls. Update for your domain: https://yourdomain.com/api

endpoints.// convert_endpoint: POST /api/convert - Transform between formats (SWIFT→ISO20022, JSON→XML, etc.)
endpoints.// archive_endpoint: POST /api/archive - Archive object immutably with recovery guarantee
endpoints.// health_endpoint: GET /api/health - Check API and backend service status

rateLimit.// rateLimit_requests_doc: Maximum requests per minute per user/key
rateLimit.// rateLimit_tokens_doc: Maximum AI tokens per day per user/key

notifications.// notification_types_doc: Types of events to notify: deployment start/finish, errors, job completion, milestones

// Instructions: 1. BACKUP THIS FILE - version control this configuration
2. REPLACE PLACEHOLDERS - update all paths, URLs, and API keys for your environment
3. SET ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES - export all API keys before deployment
4. VALIDATE JSON - use jsonlint or similar to validate syntax
6. RESTART BACKEND - restart backend_api_server.py to load configuration
7. VERIFY - test /api/config endpoint returns valid configuration
8. MONITOR - track initialization logs for configuration load errors
